text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: Stop!
source_text: Stop!

text: 停下！
source_text: 停下！

text: Die, human!
source_text: Die, human!

text: 死吧，人类！
source_text: 死吧，人类！

text: To the death.
source_text: To the death.

text: 去死吧。
source_text: 去死吧。

text: You will pay for your sins!
source_text: You will pay for your sins!

text: 你会为你的罪孽付出代价的！
source_text: 你会为你的罪孽付出代价的！

text: You are not supposed to be armed in this area, little brother. Explain yourself.
source_text: You are not supposed to be armed in this area, little brother. Explain yourself.

text: 在这里你不应该携带武器的，小弟弟。解释下吧。
source_text: 在这里你不应该携带武器的，小弟弟。解释下吧。

text: You are not supposed to be armed in this area, little sister. Explain yourself.
source_text: You are not supposed to be armed in this area, little sister. Explain yourself.

text: 在这里你不应该携带武器的，小妹妹。解释下吧。
source_text: 在这里你不应该携带武器的，小妹妹。解释下吧。

text: Hngg.
source_text: Hngg.

text: 嗯咯咯。
source_text: 嗯咯咯。

text: It's okay, I work here.
source_text: It's okay, I work here.

text: 没关系，我就在这里工作。
source_text: 没关系，我就在这里工作。

text: It's okay, I have a pass.
source_text: It's okay, I have a pass.

text: 没关系，我有通行证。
source_text: 没关系，我有通行证。

text: I am armed by permission of the Lieutenant.
source_text: I am armed by permission of the Lieutenant.

text: 中尉给了我携带武器的许可。
source_text: 中尉给了我携带武器的许可。

text: What manner of treason is this?!
source_text: What manner of treason is this?!

text: 这算哪门子的背叛？！
source_text: 这算哪门子的背叛？！

text: Show me your pass, then.
source_text: Show me your pass, then.

text: 那么把你的通行证给我看看。
source_text: 那么把你的通行证给我看看。

text: I, uh, left it in my other robe.
source_text: I, uh, left it in my other robe.

text: 我，呃，把它忘在我另外一件睡衣里了。
source_text: 我，呃，把它忘在我另外一件睡衣里了。

text: It's right here, stapled to the front of my gun.
source_text: It's right here, stapled to the front of my gun.

text: 就在这儿，在我的枪口前面。
source_text: 就在这儿，在我的枪口前面。

text: Hurry on your task then, but be warned, I'm watching you.
source_text: Hurry on your task then, but be warned, I'm watching you.

text: 那赶紧干你的活儿吧，不过警告在先，我看着你呢。
source_text: 那赶紧干你的活儿吧，不过警告在先，我看着你呢。

text: Yes, little brother. What is it that you need from me?
source_text: Yes, little brother. What is it that you need from me?

text: 是，小兄弟。你要我干什么？
source_text: 是，小兄弟。你要我干什么？

text: Yes, little sister. What is it that you need from me?
source_text: Yes, little sister. What is it that you need from me?

text: 是，小妹妹。你要我干什么？
source_text: 是，小妹妹。你要我干什么？

text: Hng!
source_text: Hng!

text: 吼！
source_text: 吼！

text: Hmm, where's this Master guy?
source_text: Hmm, where's this Master guy?

text: 呣呣，主教那家伙在哪儿？
source_text: 呣呣，主教那家伙在哪儿？

text: Praise to the Unity, brother.
source_text: Praise to the Unity, brother.

text: 赞美“同一”，兄弟。
source_text: 赞美“同一”，兄弟。

text: I am sorry, but you will have to find the way to Unity yourself.
source_text: I am sorry, but you will have to find the way to Unity yourself.

text: 我很抱歉，但是你将不得不自己寻找通向“同一”的道路。
source_text: 我很抱歉，但是你将不得不自己寻找通向“同一”的道路。

text: You are obviously a heathen! Pay for your sins!
source_text: You are obviously a heathen! Pay for your sins!

text: 你明显就是个异教徒！为你的罪孽付出代价吧！
source_text: 你明显就是个异教徒！为你的罪孽付出代价吧！

text: He resides on Level 3, as he must. Why do you ask such a silly question?
source_text: He resides on Level 3, as he must. Why do you ask such a silly question?

text: 他住在第三层，因为他必须这么做。为什么你问这个傻问题？
source_text: 他住在第三层，因为他必须这么做。为什么你问这个傻问题？

text: Oh, uh, no reason.
source_text: Oh, uh, no reason.

text: 哦，呃，没理由啊。
source_text: 哦，呃，没理由啊。

text: I am going to kick his ass from here to, uh, someplace really far away!
source_text: I am going to kick his ass from here to, uh, someplace really far away!

text: 从今以后我准备踢他的屁股，呃，确实距离比较远。
source_text: 从今以后我准备踢他的屁股，呃，确实距离比较远。

text: What question? I said 'Hail to the Master, goodbye.'
source_text: What question? I said 'Hail to the Master, goodbye.'

text: 什么问题？我说了，“向主教致意，再见。”
source_text: 什么问题？我说了，“向主教致意，再见。”

text: You insult me! Die!
source_text: You insult me! Die!

text: 你侮辱了我！死吧！
source_text: 你侮辱了我！死吧！

text: Praise to the Unity.
source_text: Praise to the Unity.

text: 赞美“同一”。
source_text: 赞美“同一”。

text: You sound like you do not believe what you say. Could this be true? Or have you left the path of righteousness?
source_text: You sound like you do not believe what you say. Could this be true? Or have you left the path of righteousness?

text: 你的声音听起来好像你并不相信你自己说的。这难道是真的吗？还是你已经远离了正道？
source_text: 你的声音听起来好像你并不相信你自己说的。这难道是真的吗？还是你已经远离了正道？

text: You mistake the tremor in my voice for fear when it is actually a cold of some sort.
source_text: You mistake the tremor in my voice for fear when it is actually a cold of some sort.

text: 你把我声音中因为寒冷而发出的战栗误认成源自恐惧了。
source_text: 你把我声音中因为寒冷而发出的战栗误认成源自恐惧了。

text: I think your kind is doomed, actually. Here, let me prove it with some help from my friends . . .
source_text: I think your kind is doomed, actually. Here, let me prove it with some help from my friends . . .

text: 我认为你的种族事实上已经注定灭亡了。来这儿，让我在我朋友的帮助下证明给你看。
source_text: 我认为你的种族事实上已经注定灭亡了。来这儿，让我在我朋友的帮助下证明给你看。

text: When you become one of us, you will not fear such minor things. Begone.
source_text: When you become one of us, you will not fear such minor things. Begone.

text: 当你成为我们的一员后，你再也不会害怕这种微不足道的东西。走开。
source_text: 当你成为我们的一员后，你再也不会害怕这种微不足道的东西。走开。

text: What do you want this time? I have little time for your talk.
source_text: What do you want this time? I have little time for your talk.

text: 这次你要干什么？我不想给你和我谈话的时间。
source_text: 这次你要干什么？我不想给你和我谈话的时间。

text: Labbo!
source_text: Labbo!

text: 妈的！
source_text: 妈的！

text: I have little time for your life . . . Die!
source_text: I have little time for your life . . . Die!

text: 我觉得你大限到了……死吧！
source_text: 我觉得你大限到了……死吧！

text: Nothing, sorry.
source_text: Nothing, sorry.

text: 没什么，抱歉。
source_text: 没什么，抱歉。

text: Praise to the Unity, brother.
source_text: Praise to the Unity, brother.

text: 赞美“同一”，兄弟。
source_text: 赞美“同一”，兄弟。

text: Just who are you? Let me see . . . Argh! An intruder . . .
source_text: Just who are you? Let me see . . . Argh! An intruder . . .

text: 可是你是谁？让我看看……啊啊！入侵者……
source_text: 可是你是谁？让我看看……啊啊！入侵者……

text: Move along. Do your part for the Unity and stop bothering me!
source_text: Move along. Do your part for the Unity and stop bothering me!

text: 行动吧。为“同一”献出你的力量，别来打搅我！
source_text: 行动吧。为“同一”献出你的力量，别来打搅我！

text: Get going.
source_text: Get going.

text: 走吧。
source_text: 走吧。

text: Move along. Do your part for the Unity.
source_text: Move along. Do your part for the Unity.

text: 行动吧。为“同一”献出你的力量。
source_text: 行动吧。为“同一”献出你的力量。
